steps.en: Staff can open and view the code list, but not the court codes
steps.id: Staff bisa membuka dan melihat daftar code, tapi bukan code dari court
steps.why_en: A code list screen exists, but it holds internal URA codes, not State Courts codes.
steps.why_id: Layar daftar code ada, namun isinya code internal URA, bukan code dari State Courts.

steps.en: Staff can view the offence code list, but not the court codes
steps.id: Staff bisa melihat daftar offence code, tapi bukan code dari court
steps.why_en: An offence rule code list exists, but it belongs to URA, not State Courts.
steps.why_id: Daftar offence rule code ada, namun milik URA, bukan code dari State Courts.

steps.en: Staff can change a code manually, but only its description and status
steps.id: Staff bisa mengubah code secara manual, tapi hanya deskripsi dan status
steps.why_en: Manual edit exists, but for internal URA codes and only description and status.
steps.why_id: Edit manual ada, namun untuk code internal URA dan hanya deskripsi dan status.

steps.en: Staff can change an offence code manually
steps.id: Staff bisa mengubah offence code secara manual
steps.why_en: Manual edit exists, but for URA rule codes, not State Courts offence codes.
steps.why_id: Edit manual ada, namun untuk rule code URA, bukan offence code dari State Courts.

steps.en: Menu dedicated to State Courts codes
steps.why_en: Only a menu name exists with no page; there is no State Courts code screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada nama menu tanpa halaman; tidak ada layar code State Courts.

steps.en: Manual edit as a backup when the interface fails
steps.id: Edit manual sebagai cadangan saat interface gagal
steps.why_en: The code interface does not exist, so there is no interface failure to back up.
steps.why_id: Interface code tidak ada, jadi tidak ada kegagalan interface yang bisa dicadangkan.
